Script.name: m_enchanter_core
Script.script:
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- m_Enchanter - Mudlet enchanting helper backed by DINV persistence ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
m_Enchanter = m_Enchanter or {} m_Enchanter.version = "1.1.4" m_Enchanter.aliases = m_Enchanter.aliases or {} m_Enchanter.triggers = m_Enchanter.triggers or {} m_Enchanter.timers = m_Enchanter.timers or {} m_Enchanter.events = m_Enchanter.events or {} m_Enchanter.pending_identifies = m_Enchanter.pending_identifies or {} m_Enchanter.active_command_queue = m_Enchanter.active_command_queue or nil m_Enchanter.next_operation_id = tonumber(m_Enchanter.next_operation_id) or 0
m_Enchanter.settings = m_Enchanter.settings or { debug = false, reporting_on = true, report_channel = "echo", quiet = false, focus_ignore = false, }
m_Enchanter.focus = m_Enchanter.focus or { status = "unknown" } m_Enchanter.pending_command = m_Enchanter.pending_command or "" m_Enchanter.pending_item_id = m_Enchanter.pending_item_id or "" m_Enchanter.last = m_Enchanter.last or nil
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- General helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function trim(value) return tostring(value or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") end
local function startsWith(value, prefix) return tostring(value or ""):sub(1, #prefix) == prefix end
local function tableCount(t) local n = 0 if type(t) == "table" then for _ in pairs(t) do n = n + 1 end end return n end
local function shallowCopy(t) local out = {} if type(t) == "table" then for k, v in pairs(t) do out[k] = v end end return out end
local function stripColors(text) if dbot and dbot.stripColors then return dbot.stripColors(text) end text = tostring(text or "") text = text:gsub("@@", "\001AT\001") text = text:gsub("@x%d+", "") text = text:gsub("@[%a]", "") text = text:gsub("\027%[[%d;]*m", "") text = text:gsub("\001AT\001", "@") return text end
function m_Enchanter.convertColors(text) if dbot and dbot.convertColors then return dbot.convertColors(text) end
local map = { ["@w"] = "<ansi_white>", ["@W"] = "<white>", ["@r"] = "<ansi_red>", ["@R"] = "<ansi_light_red>", ["@g"] = "<ansi_green>", ["@G"] = "<ansi_light_green>", ["@y"] = "<ansi_yellow>", ["@Y"] = "<ansi_light_yellow>", ["@b"] = "<ansi_blue>", ["@B"] = "<ansi_light_blue>", ["@m"] = "<ansi_magenta>", ["@M"] = "<ansi_light_magenta>", ["@c"] = "<ansi_cyan>", ["@C"] = "<ansi_light_cyan>", ["@d"] = "<ansi_black>", ["@D"] = "<ansi_light_black>", }
local function xtermToMudlet(num) num = tonumber(num) or 0 if num == 0 then return "<ansi_black>" elseif num == 1 then return "<ansi_red>" elseif num == 2 then return "<ansi_green>" elseif num == 3 then return "<ansi_yellow>" elseif num == 4 then return "<ansi_blue>" elseif num == 5 then return "<ansi_magenta>" elseif num == 6 then return "<ansi_cyan>" elseif num == 7 then return "<ansi_white>" elseif num == 8 then return "<ansi_light_black>" elseif num == 9 then return "<ansi_light_red>" elseif num == 10 then return "<ansi_light_green>" elseif num == 11 then return "<ansi_light_yellow>" elseif num == 12 then return "<ansi_light_blue>" elseif num == 13 then return "<ansi_light_magenta>" elseif num == 14 then return "<ansi_light_cyan>" elseif num == 15 then return "<white>" elseif num >= 232 then local grey = num - 232 if grey < 8 then return "<ansi_black>" elseif grey < 16 then return "<ansi_light_black>" else return "<white>" end end
local cube = num - 16 local blue = cube % 6 local green = math.floor(cube / 6) % 6 local red = math.floor(cube / 36) local bright = math.max(red, green, blue) >= 3 if red > green and red > blue then return bright and "<ansi_light_red>" or "<ansi_red>" elseif green > red and green > blue then return bright and "<ansi_light_green>" or "<ansi_green>" elseif blue > red and blue > green then return bright and "<ansi_light_blue>" or "<ansi_blue>" elseif red == green and red > blue then return bright and "<ansi_light_yellow>" or "<ansi_yellow>" elseif red == blue and red > green then return bright and "<ansi_light_magenta>" or "<ansi_magenta>" elseif green == blue and green > red then return bright and "<ansi_light_cyan>" or "<ansi_cyan>" else return bright and "<white>" or "<ansi_white>" end end
text = tostring(text or "") text = text:gsub("@@", "\001AT\001") text = text:gsub("@x(%d+)", xtermToMudlet) for code, color in pairs(map) do text = text:gsub(code:gsub("@", "%%@"), color) end text = text:gsub("\001AT\001", "@") return text end
function m_Enchanter.print(text) cecho(m_Enchanter.convertColors(tostring(text or "")) .. "\n") end
function m_Enchanter.info(text) m_Enchanter.print("@C[m_enchanter]@w " .. tostring(text or "")) end
function m_Enchanter.warn(text) m_Enchanter.print("@Y[m_enchanter]@w " .. tostring(text or "")) end
function m_Enchanter.debug(text) if m_Enchanter.settings.debug then m_Enchanter.print("@D[m_enchanter DEBUG] " .. tostring(text or "") .. "@w") end end
local function quoteTarget(target) target = trim(target) if target == "" then return target end if target:match("^%d+$") then return target end if target:find("%s") then return "'" .. target:gsub("'", "\\'") .. "'" end return target end
local function sendGameCommand(command) if m_Enchanter.settings.quiet then if sendSilent then sendSilent(command) else send(command, false) end else send(command) end end
local function sendReportLine(coloredText) local channel = trim(m_Enchanter.settings.report_channel or "echo") if channel == "" then channel = "echo" end
if channel:lower() == "echo" then m_Enchanter.print(coloredText) return end
if channel:lower() == "gchan" then local message = tostring(coloredText or "") if _G.GCH and type(GCH.send_gchan) == "function" then GCH.send_gchan(message) elseif expandAlias then expandAlias("gchan " .. message, false) else send("gchan " .. message, false) end return end
local mudChannels = { clan = true, say = true, gtell = true, gt = true, spouse = true, }
if mudChannels[channel:lower()] then -- Aardwolf channels understand Aardwolf @ color codes. send(channel .. " " .. tostring(coloredText or ""), false) elseif expandAlias then -- Custom client channels do not reliably understand Aardwolf/xterm -- markup. Do not leak literal @xNNN codes into them. expandAlias(channel .. " " .. stripColors(coloredText), false) else m_Enchanter.warn("Cannot report to custom channel '" .. channel .. "': Mudlet alias expansion is unavailable.") end end
local function niceJoin(list) list = shallowCopy(list) if #list == 0 then return "" end if #list == 1 then return list[1] end local last = table.remove(list) return table.concat(list, ", ") .. ", and " .. last end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Persistence ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function getHomeDir() if getMudletHomeDir then return getMudletHomeDir() end return "." end
local function ensureDirectory(path) path = tostring(path or ""):gsub("\\", "/") if path == "" then return false end
local ok, lfsLib = pcall(require, "lfs") local fs = ok and lfsLib or lfs if not fs then return false end
local current = "" local drive = path:match("^%a:") if drive then current = drive path = path:sub(3) elseif startsWith(path, "/") then current = "/" end
for segment in path:gmatch("[^/]+") do if current == "" then current = segment elseif current == "/" then current = current .. segment else current = current .. "/" .. segment end
if fs.attributes(current, "mode") ~= "directory" then fs.mkdir(current) end end
return true end
function m_Enchanter.getPersistenceDir() return getHomeDir() .. "/persistence/" end
function m_Enchanter.getSettingsPath() return m_Enchanter.getPersistenceDir() .. "m_enchanter.state" end
local function saveLuaTable(path, tableName, value) local dir = path:match("^(.*[/\\])[^/\\]+$") if dir then ensureDirectory(dir) end
local function serialize(v, indent) indent = indent or 0 local tv = type(v) if tv == "string" then return string.format("%q", v) elseif tv == "number" or tv == "boolean" then return tostring(v) elseif tv == "table" then local parts = { "{" } local nextIndent = indent + 4 local keys = {} for k in pairs(v) do table.insert(keys, k) end table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end) for _, k in ipairs(keys) do local keyText if type(k) == "string" and k:match("^[%a_][%w_]*$") then keyText = k else keyText = "[" .. serialize(k, nextIndent) .. "]" end table.insert(parts, string.rep(" ", nextIndent) .. keyText .. " = " .. serialize(v[k], nextIndent) .. ",") end table.insert(parts, string.rep(" ", indent) .. "}") return table.concat(parts, "\n") end return "nil" end
local f, err = io.open(path, "w") if not f then m_Enchanter.warn("Could not save settings: " .. tostring(err)) return false end f:write(tableName .. " = " .. serialize(value, 0) .. "\n") f:close() return true end
local function loadLuaFile(path) local f = io.open(path, "r") if not f then return nil end local content = f:read("*a") f:close() if not content or content == "" then return nil end
local env = { inv = { items = {} } } setmetatable(env, { __index = _G })
local chunk, err if loadstring then chunk, err = loadstring(content) if chunk and setfenv then setfenv(chunk, env) end else chunk, err = load(content, "@" .. path, "t", env) end
if not chunk then m_Enchanter.warn("Could not parse persistence file '" .. tostring(path) .. "': " .. tostring(err)) return nil end
local ok, runErr = pcall(chunk) if not ok then m_Enchanter.warn("Could not load persistence file '" .. tostring(path) .. "': " .. tostring(runErr)) return nil end
return env end
function m_Enchanter.saveSettings() local data = { debug = m_Enchanter.settings.debug and true or false, reporting_on = m_Enchanter.settings.reporting_on and true or false, report_channel = m_Enchanter.settings.report_channel or "echo", quiet = m_Enchanter.settings.quiet and true or false, focus_ignore = m_Enchanter.settings.focus_ignore and true or false, } saveLuaTable(m_Enchanter.getSettingsPath(), "m_EnchanterSettings", data) end
function m_Enchanter.loadSettings() local env = loadLuaFile(m_Enchanter.getSettingsPath()) local data = env and env.m_EnchanterSettings if type(data) ~= "table" then return end
for k, v in pairs(data) do m_Enchanter.settings[k] = v end m_Enchanter.settings.report_channel = m_Enchanter.settings.report_channel or "echo" end
function m_Enchanter.itemStatePaths() local paths = {} local seen = {} local function add(path) if path and path ~= "" and not seen[path] then seen[path] = true table.insert(paths, path) end end
add(m_Enchanter.getPersistenceDir() .. "inv-items.state") add(m_Enchanter.getPersistenceDir() .. "dinv/inv-items.state")
if dbot and dbot.backup and dbot.backup.getCurrentDir then local ok, dir = pcall(dbot.backup.getCurrentDir) if ok and dir then local separator = tostring(dir):match("[/\\]$") and "" or "/" add(tostring(dir) .. separator .. "inv-items.state") end end
return paths end
function m_Enchanter.loadItemsFromPersistence() if inv and inv.items and inv.items.loadPersistentItemsTable then local ok, items = pcall(inv.items.loadPersistentItemsTable) if ok and type(items) == "table" and tableCount(items) > 0 then return items, "dinv" end end
for _, path in ipairs(m_Enchanter.itemStatePaths()) do local env = loadLuaFile(path) local items = env and env.inv and env.inv.items and env.inv.items.table if type(items) == "table" and tableCount(items) > 0 then return items, path end end
return nil, nil end
function m_Enchanter.ensureItemsAvailable() if inv and inv.items and type(inv.items.table) == "table" and tableCount(inv.items.table) > 0 then return inv.items.table, "live" end
if inv and inv.items and inv.items.load then pcall(inv.items.load) if type(inv.items.table) == "table" and tableCount(inv.items.table) > 0 then return inv.items.table, "dinv-load" end end
local items, source = m_Enchanter.loadItemsFromPersistence() if items and inv and inv.items and (type(inv.items.table) ~= "table" or tableCount(inv.items.table) == 0) then inv.items.table = items end return items, source end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- DINV access ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function m_Enchanter.dinvReady() if DINV and DINV.api and type(DINV.api.isReady) == "function" then local ok, ready = pcall(DINV.api.isReady) if ok and ready then return true end end return inv and inv.items and inv.items.search and inv.items.getItem end
function m_Enchanter.ensureDinvReady() if not m_Enchanter.dinvReady() then m_Enchanter.warn("DINV is not loaded. Load DINV first; numeric ids can still be read from persistence if inv-items.state exists.") return false end m_Enchanter.ensureItemsAvailable() return true end
function m_Enchanter.runDinvSearch(query) query = trim(query) if not m_Enchanter.ensureDinvReady() then return false end
if inv.cli and inv.cli.main then inv.cli.main("search " .. query) return true end
local itemIds, retval = inv.items.search(query) if retval == 0 or retval == nil then if inv.items.sort then inv.items.sort(itemIds) end inv.items.displayResults(itemIds, "basic") return true end
return false end
function m_Enchanter.searchItems(query) if not m_Enchanter.ensureDinvReady() then return nil, -1 end
if DINV and DINV.api and type(DINV.api.search) == "function" then local ok, result = pcall(DINV.api.search, query, { fields = { "id" } }) if ok and type(result) == "table" and result.ok then local itemIds = {} for _, item in ipairs(result.items or {}) do if item.id ~= nil then table.insert(itemIds, tostring(item.id)) end end return itemIds, 0 end end
local itemIds, retval = inv.items.search(query) itemIds = itemIds or {} if retval == 0 or retval == nil then if inv.items.sort then inv.items.sort(itemIds) end end return itemIds, retval end
function m_Enchanter.displayItemIds(itemIds) if not itemIds or #itemIds == 0 then return end if inv and inv.items and inv.items.displayResults then inv.items.displayResults(itemIds, "basic") end end
function m_Enchanter.findItemById(objId) objId = tostring(objId or "") if objId == "" then return nil end
if DINV and DINV.api and type(DINV.api.getItem) == "function" then local ok, result = pcall(DINV.api.getItem, objId, { detail = "raw" }) if ok and type(result) == "table" and result.ok and type(result.item) == "table" then return result.item, "DINV.api" end end
if inv and inv.items and inv.items.getItem then local item = inv.items.getItem(objId) if item then return item, "live" end end
local items, source = m_Enchanter.ensureItemsAvailable() if type(items) == "table" then local item = items[objId] or items[tonumber(objId)] if item then return item, source or "persistence" end end
return nil, nil end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Item/stat helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local fieldCandidates = { id = { "id" }, name = { "name" }, colorName = { "colorname", "colorName", "coloredName" }, flags = { "flags" }, enchants = { "enchants", "enchantments", "enchantData", "enchantDetails" }, solidify = { "solidify" }, resonate = { "resonate" }, illuminate = { "illuminate" }, solidifyRemoval = { "solidifyremoval", "solidifyRemoval" }, resonateRemoval = { "resonateremoval", "resonateRemoval" }, illuminateRemoval = { "illuminateremoval", "illuminateRemoval" }, type = { "type" }, level = { "level" }, wearable = { "wearable" }, location = { "location", "loc" }, container = { "container" }, worn = { "worn" }, identifyLevel = { "identifyLevel", "idlevel" }, }
local function getStat(item, key) if not item then return nil end local stats = item.stats or item local candidates = fieldCandidates[key] or { key } for _, field in ipairs(candidates) do if stats[field] ~= nil then return stats[field] end if item[field] ~= nil then return item[field] end end return nil end
local function getDinvStat(objId, globalFieldName, fallbackField) if not (inv and inv.items and type(inv.items.getStatField) == "function") then return nil end
local field = rawget(_G, globalFieldName) or fallbackField if not field then return nil end
local ok, value = pcall(inv.items.getStatField, tostring(objId or ""), field) if ok and value ~= nil and tostring(value) ~= "" then return value end return nil end
local function normalizeTokenText(text) text = stripColors(text):lower() text = text:gsub("[,;|/]+", " ") return text end
local function hasToken(text, token) token = tostring(token or ""):lower() for word in normalizeTokenText(text):gmatch("%S+") do if word == token then return true end end return false end
local function cleanDisplayName(name) name = tostring(name or "") name = name:gsub("%s+[A-Z][a-z]+%s+%+?%-?%d+%s*%(removable[^%)]*%).*", "") name = name:gsub("%s+%(removable[^%)]*%)%s*", "") return trim(name) end
local function itemIsInInventory(item) return tostring(getStat(item, "location") or ""):lower() == "inventory" end
local function normalizeEnchantKind(value) value = tostring(value or ""):lower() if value:find("solid") then return "solidify" elseif value:find("reson") then return "resonate" elseif value:find("illum") then return "illuminate" end return nil end
local function addEnchant(details, kind, value, removable) kind = normalizeEnchantKind(kind) if not kind then return end details[kind] = details[kind] or {} table.insert(details[kind], { value = trim(value or ""), removable = trim(removable or ""), }) end
local function parseEnchantString(details, text) text = tostring(text or "") if text == "" then return end
for line in text:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do local chunks = {} if line:find(":", 1, true) then table.insert(chunks, line) else for part in line:gmatch("[^,]+") do table.insert(chunks, part) end end if #chunks == 0 then table.insert(chunks, line) end
for _, chunk in ipairs(chunks) do local kind = normalizeEnchantKind(chunk) if kind then local removable = chunk:match("%((.-)%)") or "" local value = chunk:match(":%s*(.-)%s*%(") or chunk:match(":%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if value:lower():find("removable", 1, true) then value = "" end addEnchant(details, kind, value, removable) end end end end
local function parseEnchantTable(details, value, impliedKind) if type(value) ~= "table" then if type(value) == "string" then if impliedKind then local removable = value:match("%((.-)%)") or "" local statValue = value:match("^(.-)%s*%(") or value if statValue:lower():find("removable", 1, true) then removable = removable ~= "" and removable or statValue statValue = "" end addEnchant(details, impliedKind, statValue, removable) else parseEnchantString(details, value) end end return end
local hasNumeric = false for k in pairs(value) do if type(k) == "number" then hasNumeric = true break end end
if hasNumeric then for _, entry in ipairs(value) do parseEnchantTable(details, entry, impliedKind) end return end
local kind = impliedKind or normalizeEnchantKind(value.kind or value.name or value.type or "") local removable = value.removable or value.remove or value.removal or value.source or value[2] or "" local statValue = value.value or value.stat or value.mod or value.amount or value[1] or "" if kind then addEnchant(details, kind, statValue, removable) else for k, v in pairs(value) do parseEnchantTable(details, v, normalizeEnchantKind(k)) end end end
local function getEnchantDetails(item) local details = { solidify = {}, resonate = {}, illuminate = {}, } local raw = getStat(item, "enchants") if type(raw) == "table" then parseEnchantTable(details, raw, nil) elseif type(raw) == "string" then parseEnchantString(details, raw) end
-- Current DINV stores the enchant list in `enchants`, but stores each -- enchant's values and removal mode in dedicated stat fields. for _, kind in ipairs({ "solidify", "resonate", "illuminate" }) do local statValue = getStat(item, kind) local removal = getStat(item, kind .. "Removal") if statValue ~= nil or removal ~= nil then details[kind] = {} addEnchant(details, kind, statValue or "", removal or "") end end return details end
local function hasEnchant(details, kind) local list = details and details[kind] return type(list) == "table" and #list > 0 end
local function enchantRemovalMode(details, kind) local mode = "" for _, entry in ipairs(details and details[kind] or {}) do local removal = tostring(entry.removable or ""):lower() if removal:find("enchanter", 1, true) then return "enchanter" elseif removal:find("tp", 1, true) then mode = "tp" elseif removal ~= "" and mode == "" then mode = "other" end end return mode end
local function removableText(raw) raw = tostring(raw or ""):lower() if raw == "" then return "" end if raw:find("tp", 1, true) then return "@r(removable with TP only)@w" end if raw:find("enchanter", 1, true) then return "@y(removable by enchanter)@w" end if raw:find("removable", 1, true) then return "@y(" .. raw .. ")@w" end return "" end
local function formatEnchantDetails(details, kind) local list = details and details[kind] if type(list) ~= "table" or #list == 0 then return nil end
local values = {} local removable = "" for _, entry in ipairs(list) do if entry.value and entry.value ~= "" then table.insert(values, entry.value) end local rt = removableText(entry.removable) if rt ~= "" then removable = rt end end
if #values > 0 then return "@W" .. table.concat(values, ", ") .. "@w" .. (removable ~= "" and (" " .. removable) or "") end if removable ~= "" then return "@WEnchanted@w " .. removable end return "@WAlready enchanted.@w" end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Analysis ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function m_Enchanter.buildAnalysis(objId, item, enchantDetailsOverride) local rawFlags = getStat(item, "flags") local flagParts = {} if type(rawFlags) == "table" then for key, value in pairs(rawFlags) do if type(key) == "number" then table.insert(flagParts, tostring(value)) elseif value == true or value == 1 or value == "1" then table.insert(flagParts, tostring(key)) elseif type(value) == "string" then table.insert(flagParts, value) end end table.sort(flagParts) end local flags = type(rawFlags) == "table" and table.concat(flagParts, " ") or tostring(rawFlags or "") local details = getEnchantDetails(item) for _, kind in ipairs({ "solidify", "resonate", "illuminate" }) do local captured = enchantDetailsOverride and enchantDetailsOverride[kind] if type(captured) == "table" and #captured > 0 then details[kind] = shallowCopy(captured) end end
local hasInvis = hasToken(flags, "invis") local hasHum = hasToken(flags, "hum") local hasGlow = hasToken(flags, "glow") local hasSolidified = hasToken(flags, "solidified") or hasEnchant(details, "solidify") local hasResonated = hasToken(flags, "resonated") or hasEnchant(details, "resonate") local hasIlluminated = hasToken(flags, "illuminated") or hasEnchant(details, "illuminate")
-- Read DINV's canonical database field first. API result shapes differ -- between DINV versions, while getStatField consistently resolves it. local colorName = getDinvStat(objId, "invStatFieldColorName", "colorname") or getStat(item, "colorName") or getStat(item, "name") or ("item " .. tostring(objId)) colorName = cleanDisplayName(colorName) local plainName = cleanDisplayName(stripColors(colorName)) if plainName == "" then plainName = "item " .. tostring(objId) end
local lines = {} local flagsToToggle = {}
local solidifyStatus if hasSolidified then solidifyStatus = formatEnchantDetails(details, "solidify") or "@CAlready solidified.@w" elseif hasInvis then solidifyStatus = "@gReady to enchant@w" else solidifyStatus = "@RNeeds 'invis' flag ON@w" table.insert(flagsToToggle, "invis") end table.insert(lines, "@D- @CSolidify@w: " .. solidifyStatus)
local resonateStatus if hasResonated then resonateStatus = formatEnchantDetails(details, "resonate") or "@CAlready resonated.@w" elseif hasHum then resonateStatus = "@y(Normal) No stats@w" table.insert(flagsToToggle, "hum") else resonateStatus = "@gReady to enchant@w" end table.insert(lines, "@D- @CResonate@w: " .. resonateStatus)
local illuminateStatus if hasIlluminated then illuminateStatus = formatEnchantDetails(details, "illuminate") or "@CAlready illuminated.@w" elseif hasGlow then illuminateStatus = "@y(Normal) No stats@w" table.insert(flagsToToggle, "glow") else illuminateStatus = "@gReady to enchant@w" end table.insert(lines, "@D- @CIlluminate@w: " .. illuminateStatus)
local target = tostring(objId or plainName) local pending = "" if #flagsToToggle > 0 then pending = "setflag " .. quoteTarget(target) .. " " .. table.concat(flagsToToggle, " ") end
return { id = tostring(objId or ""), item = item, colorName = colorName, plainName = plainName, flags = flags, lines = lines, pending = pending, hasInvis = hasInvis, hasHum = hasHum, hasGlow = hasGlow, hasSolidified = hasSolidified, hasResonated = hasResonated, hasIlluminated = hasIlluminated, enchantDetails = details, removalModes = { solidify = enchantRemovalMode(details, "solidify"), resonate = enchantRemovalMode(details, "resonate"), illuminate = enchantRemovalMode(details, "illuminate"), }, } end
function m_Enchanter.displayAnalysis(analysis) local title = "@DEnchantment Analysis for @w" .. analysis.colorName .. "@D (@Y" .. analysis.id .. "@D):@w" local contentLines = shallowCopy(analysis.lines) local commandLine = analysis.pending ~= "" and ("@DSuggested eqsetflags:@w @Y" .. analysis.pending .. "@w") or nil
local maxw = #stripColors(title) for _, line in ipairs(contentLines) do local width = #stripColors(line) if width > maxw then maxw = width end end if commandLine and #stripColors(commandLine) > maxw then maxw = #stripColors(commandLine) end local w = maxw + 4
local border = "<steel_blue>" local reset = "<reset>" local top = border .. "." .. string.rep("-", w) .. "." .. reset local bot = border .. "'" .. string.rep("-", w) .. "'" .. reset local sep = border .. "|-" .. string.rep("-", w - 2) .. "-|" .. reset
m_Enchanter.print(top) m_Enchanter.print(border .. "| " .. reset .. title .. string.rep(" ", w - #stripColors(title) - 1) .. border .. "|" .. reset) m_Enchanter.print(sep) for _, line in ipairs(contentLines) do local pad = string.rep(" ", w - #stripColors(line) - 2) m_Enchanter.print(border .. "| " .. reset .. line .. pad .. " " .. border .. "|" .. reset) end if commandLine then m_Enchanter.print(sep) local pad = string.rep(" ", w - #stripColors(commandLine) - 2) m_Enchanter.print(border .. "| " .. reset .. commandLine .. pad .. " " .. border .. "|" .. reset) end m_Enchanter.print(bot) end
function m_Enchanter.reportAnalysis(analysis) if not m_Enchanter.settings.reporting_on then return end
local parts = {} for _, line in ipairs(analysis.lines or {}) do local part = line:gsub("^@D%- ", "") table.insert(parts, part) end
local name = (analysis.colorName and analysis.colorName ~= "") and analysis.colorName or analysis.plainName sendReportLine(name .. "@w - " .. table.concat(parts, ", ")) end
function m_Enchanter.analyzeId(objId, options) options = options or {} objId = tostring(objId or ""):match("^(%d+)$") if not objId then m_Enchanter.warn("Usage: eqanalyze <id|name>") return nil end
local item, source = m_Enchanter.findItemById(objId) if not item then m_Enchanter.warn("No DINV persistence entry found for id " .. tostring(objId) .. ". Run 'dinv search " .. tostring(objId) .. "' or refresh DINV.") return nil end
m_Enchanter.debug("Analyzing id " .. tostring(objId) .. " from " .. tostring(source or "unknown")) local analysis = m_Enchanter.buildAnalysis(objId, item, options.enchantDetails) m_Enchanter.last = analysis m_Enchanter.pending_command = analysis.pending or "" m_Enchanter.pending_item_id = analysis.id or ""
if options.display ~= false then m_Enchanter.displayAnalysis(analysis) end if options.report ~= false then m_Enchanter.reportAnalysis(analysis) end
return analysis end
function m_Enchanter.resolveQuery(query, options) options = options or {} query = trim(query) if query == "" then return nil end
if query:match("^%d+$") then local item = m_Enchanter.findItemById(query) if item then return query end m_Enchanter.warn("No DINV persistence entry found for id " .. query .. ".") return nil end
local itemIds, retval = m_Enchanter.searchItems(query) if not itemIds then return nil end
if options.displaySearch or #itemIds ~= 1 then m_Enchanter.runDinvSearch(query) end
if #itemIds == 1 then return tostring(itemIds[1]) elseif #itemIds > 1 and options.warnMultiple ~= false then m_Enchanter.warn("Multiple DINV matches for '" .. query .. "'. Refine the name or use an id.") end return nil end
function m_Enchanter.resolveNameInventoryFirst(query, options) options = options or {} query = trim(query) if query == "" then return nil end
local itemIds = m_Enchanter.searchItems(query) if not itemIds then return nil end
local inventoryIds = {} for _, objId in ipairs(itemIds) do local item = m_Enchanter.findItemById(objId) if item and itemIsInInventory(item) then table.insert(inventoryIds, tostring(objId)) end end
if #inventoryIds == 1 then return inventoryIds[1] elseif #inventoryIds > 1 then m_Enchanter.displayItemIds(inventoryIds) if options.warnMultiple ~= false then m_Enchanter.warn("Multiple inventory matches for '" .. query .. "'. Refine the name or use an id.") end return nil end
return m_Enchanter.resolveQuery(query, options) end
function m_Enchanter.eqAnalyze(rawArg) local arg = trim(rawArg) if arg == "" or arg:lower() == "help" then m_Enchanter.showHelp() return end
local debugMode = arg:match("^debug%s+(on|off)$") if debugMode then m_Enchanter.settings.debug = (debugMode == "on") m_Enchanter.saveSettings() m_Enchanter.info("Debug mode is now " .. (m_Enchanter.settings.debug and "ON" or "OFF") .. ".") return end
if arg:match("^%d+$") then m_Enchanter.analyzeId(arg) return end
local objId = m_Enchanter.resolveNameInventoryFirst(arg, { displaySearch = true, warnMultiple = false }) if objId then m_Enchanter.analyzeId(objId) end end

function m_Enchanter.onFocusTimer(mm, ss) local seconds = (tonumber(mm) or 0) * 60 + (tonumber(ss) or 0) m_Enchanter.focus_check_pending = false if m_Enchanter.timers.focusCheck and killTimer then pcall(killTimer, m_Enchanter.timers.focusCheck) m_Enchanter.timers.focusCheck = nil end m_Enchanter.focus.status = "up" m_Enchanter.debug(string.format("Focus up, %02d:%02d remaining.", tonumber(mm) or 0, tonumber(ss) or 0)) m_Enchanter.scheduleFocus(seconds) end

m_Enchanter.timers.saffectsTip = tempTimer(0.5, function() if m_Enchanter.triggers.saffectsTip then pcall(killTrigger, m_Enchanter.triggers.saffectsTip) m_Enchanter.triggers.saffectsTip = nil end m_Enchanter.timers.saffectsTip = nil end) end

You can enchant without focus.") else m_Enchanter.info("Focus ignore disabled. Enchanting requires active focus.") end end

Use 'eqfocus' or 'eqfocusignore on'.") return false end m_Enchanter.warn("Cannot enchant: Focus status is UNKNOWN. Run 'eqfocus' first or use 'eqfocusignore on'.") return false end

function m_Enchanter.sendAndNote(command) sendGameCommand(command) m_Enchanter.print("@C -> Sent: @w" .. command) end
local function reportRemovedEnchants(objId, context) context = context or {} local analysis = m_Enchanter.analyzeId(objId, { display = false, report = false }) if not m_Enchanter.settings.reporting_on then return end
local names = {} local failures = {} local pretty = { solidify = "Solidify", resonate = "Resonate", illuminate = "Illuminate" } for _, enchantKind in ipairs(context.removedKinds or {}) do if analysis and analysis.enchantDetails and not hasEnchant(analysis.enchantDetails, enchantKind) then table.insert(names, pretty[enchantKind] or enchantKind) else table.insert(failures, pretty[enchantKind] or enchantKind) end end if #failures > 0 then m_Enchanter.warn("DINV still shows these enchants after the operation: " .. table.concat(failures, ", ") .. ".") end if #names == 0 then return end
local itemName = (analysis and analysis.colorName and analysis.colorName ~= "" and analysis.colorName) or (analysis and analysis.plainName) or context.plainName or ("item " .. tostring(objId)) local msg = (#names == 1) and ("Removed " .. names[1] .. " from " .. itemName) or (niceJoin(names) .. " removed from " .. itemName) sendReportLine(msg) end
function m_Enchanter.finishPostIdentify(objId, context) context = context or {} local kind = context.kind or "analysis"
if kind == "disenchant" then reportRemovedEnchants(objId, context) return end
local analysis = m_Enchanter.analyzeId(objId, { display = false, report = false, enchantDetails = context.enchantDetails, }) if analysis then m_Enchanter.reportAnalysis(analysis) end end
local function splitCapturedEnchantValue(value) value = trim(stripColors(value)) local removable = value:match("%((.-)%)%s*$") or "" local statValue = trim(value:gsub("%s*%([^()]*%)%s*$", "")) return statValue, removable end
function m_Enchanter.onDinvIdentifyEnchantLine(kind, value) local objId = m_Enchanter.identify_capture_id local pending = objId and m_Enchanter.pending_identifies[objId] kind = normalizeEnchantKind(kind) if not pending or not kind then return end
pending.context.enchantDetails = pending.context.enchantDetails or { solidify = {}, resonate = {}, illuminate = {}, } local statValue, removable = splitCapturedEnchantValue(value) pending.context.enchantDetails[kind] = {} addEnchant(pending.context.enchantDetails, kind, statValue, removable) pending.lastEnchantKind = kind end
function m_Enchanter.onDinvIdentifyEnchantContinuation(value) local objId = m_Enchanter.identify_capture_id local pending = objId and m_Enchanter.pending_identifies[objId] local kind = pending and pending.lastEnchantKind local details = pending and pending.context and pending.context.enchantDetails local list = details and kind and details[kind] local entry = type(list) == "table" and list[#list] or nil if not entry then return end
local statValue, removable = splitCapturedEnchantValue(value) if statValue ~= "" then entry.value = entry.value ~= "" and (entry.value .. ", " .. statValue) or statValue end if removable ~= "" then entry.removable = removable end end
function m_Enchanter.onDinvIdentifyComplete(eventName, objId) if objId == nil and tostring(eventName or "") ~= "DINV.identifyComplete" then objId = eventName end
objId = tostring(objId or ""):match("^(%d+)$") if not objId then return end
local pending = m_Enchanter.pending_identifies and m_Enchanter.pending_identifies[objId] if not pending then return end
if pending.timeoutTimer and killTimer then pcall(killTimer, pending.timeoutTimer) end m_Enchanter.pending_identifies[objId] = nil if m_Enchanter.identify_capture_id == objId then m_Enchanter.identify_capture_id = nil end m_Enchanter.finishPostIdentify(objId, pending.context) end
function m_Enchanter.queuePostIdentifyReport(objId, context) objId = tostring(objId or "") if objId == "" then return nil end
m_Enchanter.next_operation_id = m_Enchanter.next_operation_id + 1 local token = m_Enchanter.next_operation_id local pending = { context = context or {}, startedAt = os.time(), token = token, } pending.context.enchantDetails = nil m_Enchanter.pending_identifies[objId] = pending m_Enchanter.identify_capture_id = objId
pending.timeoutTimer = tempTimer(15, function() local current = m_Enchanter.pending_identifies and m_Enchanter.pending_identifies[objId] if not current or current.token ~= token then return end
m_Enchanter.pending_identifies[objId] = nil if m_Enchanter.identify_capture_id == objId then m_Enchanter.identify_capture_id = nil end m_Enchanter.warn("DINV identify completion was not received within 15 seconds for item " .. objId .. "; skipped the post-operation report to avoid stale data.") end) return pending end
function m_Enchanter.requestDinvIdentify(objId) objId = tostring(objId or "") if objId == "" then return false, "missing item id" end
if DINV and DINV.actions and type(DINV.actions.identify) == "function" then local ok, result = pcall(DINV.actions.identify, objId, { source = "m_enchanter" }) if ok and type(result) == "table" and result.ok then return true end if not (ok and type(result) == "table" and result.code == "UNSUPPORTED") then return false, ok and tostring(result and (result.message or result.code) or "request rejected") or tostring(result) end end
-- Compatibility with DINV API v2, whose public action namespace was -- read-only but whose targeted identify implementation already existed. if inv and inv.items and type(inv.items.identifySingleItem) == "function" then local ok, retval = pcall(inv.items.identifySingleItem, objId, "m_enchanter") if ok and tonumber(retval) == tonumber(DRL_RET_SUCCESS or 0) then return true end return false, ok and ("return code " .. tostring(retval)) or tostring(retval) end
return false, "DINV targeted-identify API is unavailable" end
function m_Enchanter.schedulePostOperationIdentify(objId, delay, context) objId = tostring(objId or "") if objId == "" then return end
delay = tonumber(delay) or 0 tempTimer(delay, function() local pending = m_Enchanter.queuePostIdentifyReport(objId, context) if not pending then return end local accepted, reason = m_Enchanter.requestDinvIdentify(objId) if accepted then return end
local current = m_Enchanter.pending_identifies and m_Enchanter.pending_identifies[objId] if current and current.token == pending.token then if current.timeoutTimer and killTimer then pcall(killTimer, current.timeoutTimer) end m_Enchanter.pending_identifies[objId] = nil if m_Enchanter.identify_capture_id == objId then m_Enchanter.identify_capture_id = nil end end m_Enchanter.warn("Could not start DINV identify for item " .. objId .. ": " .. tostring(reason) .. ".") end) end
function m_Enchanter.ensureInventoryThen(objId, callback) objId = tostring(objId or "") if objId == "" then return end
local item = m_Enchanter.findItemById(objId) if item and itemIsInInventory(item) then tempTimer(0, callback) return end
local function finishRetrieve(result) local refreshed = m_Enchanter.findItemById(objId) if result and (result.timedOut or #(result.failures or {}) > 0) then m_Enchanter.warn("DINV could not confirm that item " .. objId .. " reached inventory; enchant command was not sent.") return end if not (refreshed and itemIsInInventory(refreshed)) then m_Enchanter.warn("Item " .. objId .. " is not in main inventory; enchant command was not sent.") return end tempTimer(0.1, callback) end
if not (DINV and DINV.actions) then m_Enchanter.warn("DINV controlled inventory actions are unavailable. Move item " .. objId .. " to main inventory first.") return end
local worn = tostring(getStat(item, "worn") or ""):lower() local isWorn = worn ~= "" and worn ~= "undefined" and worn ~= "not-worn" and worn ~= "not worn" local action = isWorn and DINV.actions.remove or DINV.actions.retrieve if type(action) ~= "function" then m_Enchanter.warn("DINV cannot retrieve item " .. objId .. "; move it to main inventory first.") return end
local ok, result = pcall(action, objId, { label = "m_enchanter retrieve", report = false, timeout = 10, onFinish = finishRetrieve, }) if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" or not result.ok then m_Enchanter.warn("DINV inventory request failed for item " .. objId .. ": " .. tostring(ok and result and (result.message or result.code) or result) .. ".") return end if not result.operationId then tempTimer(0, function() finishRetrieve(nil) end) end end
function m_Enchanter.abortCommandQueue(message) local queue = m_Enchanter.active_command_queue if not queue then return end if queue.timeoutTimer and killTimer then pcall(killTimer, queue.timeoutTimer) end m_Enchanter.active_command_queue = nil m_Enchanter.warn(message or "Command queue stopped; DINV identify was not started.") end
function m_Enchanter.sendNextQueuedCommand(operationId) local queue = m_Enchanter.active_command_queue if not queue or queue.id ~= operationId then return end
queue.index = queue.index + 1 local command = queue.commands[queue.index] if not command then m_Enchanter.active_command_queue = nil if queue.objId then m_Enchanter.schedulePostOperationIdentify(queue.objId, 0.2, queue.context) end return end
queue.waitingForPrompt = true queue.timeoutTimer = tempTimer(10, function() local current = m_Enchanter.active_command_queue if current and current.id == operationId and current.waitingForPrompt then m_Enchanter.abortCommandQueue("No Aardwolf prompt/vitals confirmation arrived within 10 seconds after '" .. command .. "'. Queue stopped and DINV identify was skipped.") end end) m_Enchanter.sendAndNote(command) end
function m_Enchanter.onCommandPrompt() local queue = m_Enchanter.active_command_queue if not queue or not queue.waitingForPrompt then return end
queue.waitingForPrompt = false if queue.timeoutTimer and killTimer then pcall(killTimer, queue.timeoutTimer) queue.timeoutTimer = nil end local operationId = queue.id tempTimer(0.1, function() m_Enchanter.sendNextQueuedCommand(operationId) end) end
function m_Enchanter.onCommandResponseLine() local queue = m_Enchanter.active_command_queue if not queue or not queue.waitingForPrompt then return end
local operationId = queue.id local commandIndex = queue.index tempTimer(0.4, function() local current = m_Enchanter.active_command_queue if current and current.id == operationId and current.index == commandIndex and current.waitingForPrompt then m_Enchanter.onCommandPrompt() end end) end
function m_Enchanter.onDisenchantBlockHeader() local queue = m_Enchanter.active_command_queue local command = queue and queue.commands and queue.commands[queue.index] or "" if queue and queue.waitingForPrompt and tostring(command):lower():match("^disenchant%s") then queue.inDisenchantBlock = true end end
function m_Enchanter.onDisenchantBlockBorder() local queue = m_Enchanter.active_command_queue if queue and queue.waitingForPrompt and queue.inDisenchantBlock then queue.inDisenchantBlock = false m_Enchanter.onCommandPrompt() end end
function m_Enchanter.scheduleCommands(commands, label, objId, postIdentifyContext) if #commands == 0 then return false end if m_Enchanter.active_command_queue then m_Enchanter.warn("Another enchant/disenchant command queue is already active.") return false end if tableCount(m_Enchanter.pending_identifies) > 0 then m_Enchanter.warn("DINV is still completing a previous post-operation identify; wait for that report before starting another operation.") return false end
m_Enchanter.next_operation_id = m_Enchanter.next_operation_id + 1 local operationId = m_Enchanter.next_operation_id m_Enchanter.active_command_queue = { id = operationId, commands = shallowCopy(commands), index = 0, objId = objId and tostring(objId) or nil, context = postIdentifyContext or {}, waitingForPrompt = false, } m_Enchanter.info(label .. ": " .. table.concat(commands, " ; ")) m_Enchanter.sendNextQueuedCommand(operationId) return true end
function m_Enchanter.resolveForAction(arg) arg = trim(arg) if arg == "" then if m_Enchanter.last and m_Enchanter.last.id and m_Enchanter.last.id ~= "" then local objId = tostring(m_Enchanter.last.id) return objId, m_Enchanter.analyzeId(objId, { display = false, report = false }) end return nil, nil end
local objId if arg:match("^%d+$") then objId = m_Enchanter.resolveQuery(arg, { displaySearch = false }) else objId = m_Enchanter.resolveNameInventoryFirst(arg, { displaySearch = false }) end if not objId then return nil, nil end local analysis = m_Enchanter.analyzeId(objId, { display = false, report = false }) return objId, analysis end
function m_Enchanter.eqEnchant(arg) if not m_Enchanter.focusAllowsEnchant() then return end
arg = trim(arg) local fastArg = arg:match("^fast%s+(.+)$") if fastArg then m_Enchanter.eqEnchantFast(fastArg) return elseif arg == "fast" then m_Enchanter.warn("Usage: eqenchant fast <id|name>") return end
local objId, analysis = m_Enchanter.resolveForAction(arg) if not objId or not analysis then m_Enchanter.warn("Usage: eqenchant [id|name] after 'eqanalyze <id|name>'.") return end
local target = quoteTarget(objId) local commands = {} if analysis.hasInvis and not analysis.hasSolidified then table.insert(commands, "cast solidify " .. target) end if (not analysis.hasHum) and not analysis.hasResonated then table.insert(commands, "cast resonate " .. target) end if (not analysis.hasGlow) and not analysis.hasIlluminated then table.insert(commands, "cast illuminate " .. target) end
if #commands == 0 then if analysis.pending and analysis.pending ~= "" then m_Enchanter.warn("Run 'eqsetflags confirm' first, then analyze again before enchanting.") return end m_Enchanter.warn("Nothing to enchant for " .. analysis.plainName .. " (flags/enchants do not permit).") return end
m_Enchanter.ensureInventoryThen(objId, function() m_Enchanter.scheduleCommands(commands, "Queueing enchants", objId, { kind = "enchant" }) end) end
function m_Enchanter.eqEnchantFast(arg) if not m_Enchanter.focusAllowsEnchant() then return end
local objId if arg:match("^%d+$") then objId = m_Enchanter.resolveQuery(arg, { displaySearch = false }) else objId = m_Enchanter.resolveNameInventoryFirst(arg, { displaySearch = false }) end if not objId then m_Enchanter.warn("Usage: eqenchant fast <id|name>") return end
local target = quoteTarget(objId) m_Enchanter.ensureInventoryThen(objId, function() m_Enchanter.scheduleCommands({ "cast solidify " .. target, "cast resonate " .. target, "cast illuminate " .. target, }, "Queueing enchants (fast)", objId, { kind = "enchant" }) end) end
function m_Enchanter.eqDisenchant(rest) if not m_Enchanter.focusAllowsEnchant() then return end
rest = trim(rest) if rest == "" then m_Enchanter.warn("Usage: eqdisenchant [id|name] <all|solidify|resonate|illuminate> ...") return end
local tokens = {} for token in rest:gmatch("%S+") do table.insert(tokens, token) end
local valid = { solidify = true, resonate = true, illuminate = true } local itemTokens, params = {}, {} local hasAll = false for _, token in ipairs(tokens) do local lower = token:lower() if valid[lower] then table.insert(params, lower) elseif lower == "all" then hasAll = true else table.insert(itemTokens, token) end end
if hasAll then params = { "solidify", "resonate", "illuminate" } end if #params == 0 then m_Enchanter.warn("Please specify 'all' or at least one of: solidify, resonate, illuminate.") return end
local itemArg = table.concat(itemTokens, " ") local objId, analysis = m_Enchanter.resolveForAction(itemArg) if not objId then m_Enchanter.warn("No item specified and no previous eqanalyze item remembered.") return end
local target = quoteTarget(objId) local pretty = { solidify = "Solidify", resonate = "Resonate", illuminate = "Illuminate" } local commands = {} local removedKinds = {} local skipped = {} for _, param in ipairs(params) do local mode = analysis and analysis.removalModes and analysis.removalModes[param] or "" if mode == "enchanter" then -- Aardwolf previews an enchanter removal unless confirm is present; -- without it, nothing changes and DINV correctly retains the enchant. table.insert(commands, "disenchant " .. target .. " " .. pretty[param] .. " confirm") table.insert(removedKinds, param) elseif mode == "tp" then table.insert(skipped, pretty[param] .. " requires TP") elseif analysis and analysis.enchantDetails and hasEnchant(analysis.enchantDetails, param) then table.insert(skipped, pretty[param] .. " is not marked removable by an enchanter") else table.insert(skipped, pretty[param] .. " is not present as a stored enchant") end end if #skipped > 0 then m_Enchanter.info("Skipped: " .. table.concat(skipped, "; ") .. ".") end if #commands == 0 then m_Enchanter.warn("No requested enchants are currently removable by an enchanter.") return end m_Enchanter.ensureInventoryThen(objId, function() m_Enchanter.scheduleCommands(commands, "Queueing disenchants", objId, { kind = "disenchant", removedKinds = removedKinds, plainName = analysis and analysis.plainName or nil, }) end) end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Mudlet alias/trigger registration ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function killKnownIds(t, killFn) for key, id in pairs(t or {}) do if id then pcall(killFn, id) end t[key] = nil end end
function m_Enchanter.registerAliases() killKnownIds(m_Enchanter.aliases, killAlias)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqanalyze = tempAlias([[^eqanalyze(?:\s+(.*))?$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqAnalyze(matches[2] or "") end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqa = tempAlias([[^eqa(?:\s+(.*))?$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqAnalyze(matches[2] or "") end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqe = tempAlias([[^eqe(?:\s+(.*))?$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqEnchant(matches[2] or "") end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqd = tempAlias([[^eqd(?:\s+(.*))?$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqDisenchant(matches[2] or "") end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqsetflags = tempAlias([[^eqsetflags(?:\s+(confirm))?$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqSetFlags(matches[2] or "") end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqreport = tempAlias([[^eqreport\s+(on|off)$]], function() m_Enchanter.setReport((matches[2] or ""):lower()) end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqreportchannel = tempAlias([[^eqreportchannel\s+(.+)$]], function() m_Enchanter.setReportChannel(matches[2] or "echo") end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqquiet = tempAlias([[^eqquiet\s+(on|off)$]], function() m_Enchanter.setQuiet((matches[2] or ""):lower()) end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqenchant = tempAlias([[^eqenchant(?:\s+(.*))?$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqEnchant(matches[2] or "") end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqdisenchant = tempAlias([[^eqdisenchant(?:\s+(.*))?$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqDisenchant(matches[2] or "") end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqfocus = tempAlias([[^eqfocus$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqFocus() end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqfocusignore = tempAlias([[^eqfocusignore\s+(on|off)$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqFocusIgnore((matches[2] or ""):lower()) end)
m_Enchanter.aliases.eqsetup = tempAlias([[^eqsetup\s+race\s+(.+)$]], function() m_Enchanter.eqSetupRace(matches[2] or "") end) end
function m_Enchanter.registerTriggers() killKnownIds(m_Enchanter.triggers, killTrigger)
m_Enchanter.triggers.focusTimer = tempRegexTrigger( [[^\s*Enchanters\s+focus\s*:\s*100% enchanters focus \((\d{2}):(\d{2})\)\s*$]], function() m_Enchanter.onFocusTimer(matches[2], matches[3]) end ) m_Enchanter.triggers.focusActivated = tempRegexTrigger( [[^Your enchanting skills feel more focused\.$]], function() m_Enchanter.onFocusActivated() end ) m_Enchanter.triggers.noAffects = tempRegexTrigger( [[^You are not affected by any skills or spells\.$]], function() m_Enchanter.onNoAffects() end ) m_Enchanter.triggers.focusFaded = tempRegexTrigger( [[^Your enchanters focus fades\.$]], function() m_Enchanter.onFocusFaded() end ) m_Enchanter.triggers.commandCastOutcome = tempRegexTrigger( [[^(?:You solidify .+ making it visible again\.|.+ begins to hum softly\.|.+ starts to glow brightly as you infuse it with holy magic\.)$]], function() m_Enchanter.onCommandResponseLine() end ) m_Enchanter.triggers.commandDisenchantOutcome = tempRegexTrigger( [[^(?i:.*(?:(?:disenchant|remov(?:e|ed|able)).*(?:solidify|resonate|illuminate)|(?:solidify|resonate|illuminate).*(?:disenchant|remov(?:e|ed|able))).*)$]], function() m_Enchanter.onCommandResponseLine() end ) m_Enchanter.triggers.identifyEnchantLine = tempRegexTrigger( [[^\|\s*(Solidify|Resonate|Illuminate)\s*:\s*(.*?)\s*\|\s*$]], function() m_Enchanter.onDinvIdentifyEnchantLine(matches[2], matches[3]) end ) m_Enchanter.triggers.identifyEnchantContinuation = tempRegexTrigger( [[^\|\s*:\s*(.*?)\s*\|\s*$]], function() m_Enchanter.onDinvIdentifyEnchantContinuation(matches[2]) end ) m_Enchanter.triggers.disenchantBlockHeader = tempRegexTrigger( [[^\|\s*Enchants:\s*\|$]], function() m_Enchanter.onDisenchantBlockHeader() end ) m_Enchanter.triggers.disenchantBlockBorder = tempRegexTrigger( [[^\+-+\+$]], function() m_Enchanter.onDisenchantBlockBorder() end ) end
function m_Enchanter.registerEvents() if not registerAnonymousEventHandler then m_Enchanter.warn("Mudlet event handlers are unavailable; post-identify reports need DINV.identifyComplete.") return end
local function replaceEvent(key, eventName, callback) if m_Enchanter.events[key] then if not killAnonymousEventHandler then return end pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, m_Enchanter.events[key]) m_Enchanter.events[key] = nil end m_Enchanter.events[key] = registerAnonymousEventHandler(eventName, callback) end
replaceEvent("dinvIdentifyComplete", "DINV.identifyComplete", m_Enchanter.onDinvIdentifyComplete) replaceEvent("commandPrompt", "gmcp.char.vitals", m_Enchanter.onCommandPrompt) end
function m_Enchanter.initialize() m_Enchanter.loadSettings() m_Enchanter.registerAliases() m_Enchanter.registerTriggers() m_Enchanter.registerEvents() m_Enchanter.info("v" .. m_Enchanter.version .. " loaded. Use 'eqanalyze help' or 'eqa help'.") end
m_Enchanter.initialize()
